features.name: ordinal_group1_mean
features.description: Mean of the first group of ordinal features (a1-a5), capturing the central tendency of the first ordinal dimension block normalized to [0,1]
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth continuous summary of the first ordinal block useful for linear margin separation

features.name: ordinal_group2_mean
features.description: Mean of the second group of ordinal features (a6-a10), capturing the central tendency of the second ordinal dimension block normalized to [0,1]
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth continuous summary of the second ordinal block useful for linear margin separation

features.name: continuous_group1_log_mean
features.description: Log-transformed mean of continuous features a11-a15, reducing right skew for linear models
features.expected_model_benefit: Log normalization of skewed continuous features improves linear separability

features.name: continuous_group2_log_mean
features.description: Log-transformed mean of continuous features a16-a20, reducing right skew for linear models
features.expected_model_benefit: Log normalization of skewed continuous features improves linear separability

features.name: ordinal_spread
features.description: Range of ordinal values across all 10 ordinal features (a1-a10), measuring dispersion normalized to [0,1]
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures heterogeneity across ordinal dimensions which may correlate with grouping structure
features.formula: (np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(a1, a2), a3), a4), a5), a6), a7), a8), a9), a10) - np.minimum(np.minimum(np.minimum(np.minimum(np.minimum(np.minimum(np.minimum(np.minimum(np.minimum(a1, a2), a3), a4), a5), a6), a7), a8), a9), a10)) / 4.0

features.name: continuous_ratio_g1_g2
features.description: Ratio of log-mean of continuous group 1 (a11-a15) to log-mean of continuous group 2 (a16-a20), capturing relative magnitude between groups
features.expected_model_benefit: Ratio features capture multiplicative relationships useful for linear SVM decision boundaries

features.name: ordinal_monotonicity_score
features.description: Score measuring how monotonically increasing the ordinal sequence a1-a5 is, based on consecutive differences
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures structural ordering patterns in ordinal features that may distinguish groups

features.name: continuous_log_spread
features.description: Log-transformed range between max and min of all continuous features (a11-a20), measuring spread in log space
features.expected_model_benefit: Spread in continuous features may indicate different data generation processes across groups
features.formula: np.log1p(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(a11, a12), a13), a14), a15), a16), a17), a18), a19), a20) - np.minimum(np.minimum(np.minimum(np.minimum(np.minimum(np.minimum(np.minimum(np.minimum(np.minimum(a11, a12), a13), a14), a15), a16), a17), a18), a19), a20))

features.name: ordinal_cross_group_diff
features.description: Normalized difference between mean of ordinal group 1 (a1-a5) and mean of ordinal group 2 (a6-a10)
features.expected_model_benefit: Cross-group contrast features provide linear projections that separate groups with different ordinal profiles

features.name: weighted_ordinal_composite
features.description: Weighted composite of all ordinal features with linearly increasing weights, emphasizing higher-indexed features
features.expected_model_benefit: Weighted composites provide approximate linear projections that can capture dominant ordinal trends

features.name: continuous_tail_severity
features.description: Semantic assessment of how extreme the continuous feature values are relative to typical range, scored 0 (all near minimum) to 1 (all near maximum of 39)
features.expected_model_benefit: Severity scores provide smooth normalized inputs that help linear SVM identify extreme-value groups

features.name: ordinal_uniformity_score
features.description: Semantic assessment of how uniform (similar) the ordinal values are across all 10 ordinal features, scored 0 (highly varied) to 1 (all identical)
features.expected_model_benefit: Uniformity captures whether a row has consistent ordinal responses, which may distinguish structured groups
